description.text:
The most quintessentially British Perfumer
Redefining heritage for the modern day, Penhaligon's is a creative British perfumer founded in 1870. Respect for tradition, a longstanding relationship with royalty.

Penhaligon's offers their luxurious range of fragrances for men and women as well as returning to their roots as a barber. Customers can explore Penhaligon's fragrances, immersing themselves in luxurious stories or treat themselves to a classic wet shave.

The store features an elegant new design created for the brand by architects Al-Jawad Pike which plays on the brands heritage yet offers a sleek and contemporary environment.

Location: Cabot Place
